versos.grego: Τῇ ἐλευθερίᾳ ἡμᾶς Χριστὸς ἠλευθέρωσεν· στήκετε οὖν καὶ μὴ πάλιν ζυγῷ δουλείας ἐνέχεσθε.

controles.web: Stand firm therefore in the liberty by which Christ has made us free, and don’t be entangled again with a yoke of bondage.
controles.kjv: Stand fast therefore in the liberty wherewith Christ hath made us free, and be not entangled again with the yoke of bondage.
controles.livre: Para a liberdade Cristo nos libertou; portanto, estai firmes, e não volteis a vos prender com o jugo da escravidão.

versos.grego: Ἴδε ἐγὼ Παῦλος λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι ἐὰν περιτέμνησθε Χριστὸς ὑμᾶς οὐδὲν ὠφελήσει.

controles.web: Behold, I, Paul, tell you that if you receive circumcision, Christ will profit you nothing.
controles.kjv: Behold, I Paul say unto you, that if ye be circumcised, Christ shall profit you nothing.
controles.livre: Eis que eu, Paulo, vos digo, que se vos deixardes circuncidar, Cristo vos será útil em nada.

versos.grego: μαρτύρομαι δὲ πάλιν παντὶ ἀνθρώπῳ περιτεμνομένῳ ὅτι ὀφειλέτης ἐστὶν ὅλον τὸν νόμον ποιῆσαι.

controles.web: Yes, I testify again to every man who receives circumcision, that he is a debtor to do the whole law.
controles.kjv: For I testify again to every man that is circumcised, that he is a debtor to do the whole law.
controles.livre: E de novo atesto que todo homem que se deixar circuncidar está obrigado a obedecer a toda a Lei.

versos.grego: κατηργήθητε ἀπὸ Χριστοῦ οἵτινες ἐν νόμῳ δικαιοῦσθε, τῆς χάριτος ἐξεπέσατε.

controles.web: You are alienated from Christ, you who desire to be justified by the law. You have fallen away from grace.
controles.kjv: Christ is become of no effect unto you, whosoever of you are justified by the law; ye are fallen from grace.
controles.livre: Desligados estais de Cristo, vós que quereis ser justos pela Lei; da graça caístes.

versos.grego: ἡμεῖς γὰρ Πνεύματι ἐκ πίστεως ἐλπίδα δικαιοσύνης ἀπεκδεχόμεθα.

controles.web: For we, through the Spirit, by faith wait for the hope of righteousness.
controles.kjv: For we through the Spirit wait for the hope of righteousness by faith.
controles.livre: Pois, por meio do Espírito, pela fé, aguardamos a esperança da justiça;

versos.grego: ἐν γὰρ Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ οὔτε περιτομή τι ἰσχύει οὔτε ἀκροβυστία, ἀλλὰ πίστις δι’ ἀγάπης ἐνεργουμένη.

controles.web: For in Christ Jesus neither circumcision amounts to anything, nor uncircumcision, but faith working through love.
controles.kjv: For in Jesus Christ neither circumcision availeth any thing, nor uncircumcision; but faith which worketh by love.
controles.livre: porque, em Cristo Jesus, nem a circuncisão nem a incircuncisão tem valor algum; mas sim a fé, que opera por meio do amor.

versos.grego: Ἐτρέχετε καλῶς· τίς ὑμᾶς ἐνέκοψεν ἀληθείᾳ μὴ πείθεσθαι;

controles.web: You were running well! Who interfered with you that you should not obey the truth?
controles.kjv: Ye did run well; who did hinder you that ye should not obey the truth?
controles.livre: Estáveis correndo bem; quem vos impediu de obedecerdes à verdade?

versos.grego: ἡ πεισμονὴ οὐκ ἐκ τοῦ καλοῦντος ὑμᾶς.

controles.web: This persuasion is not from him who calls you.
controles.kjv: This persuasion cometh not of him that calleth you.
controles.livre: Esta persuasão não parte daquele que vos chama.

versos.grego: μικρὰ ζύμη ὅλον τὸ φύραμα ζυμοῖ.

controles.web: A little yeast grows through the whole lump.
controles.kjv: A little leaven leaveneth the whole lump.
controles.livre: Um pouco de fermento leveda toda a massa.

versos.grego: ἐγὼ πέποιθα εἰς ὑμᾶς ἐν Κυρίῳ ὅτι οὐδὲν ἄλλο φρονήσετε· ὁ δὲ ταράσσων ὑμᾶς βαστάσει τὸ κρίμα, ὅστις ἐὰν ᾖ.

controles.web: I have confidence toward you in the Lord that you will think no other way. But he who troubles you will bear his judgment, whoever he is.
controles.kjv: I have confidence in you through the Lord, that ye will be none otherwise minded: but he that troubleth you shall bear his judgment, whosoever he be.
controles.livre: Acerca de vós, confio no Senhor de que não mudareis a vossa mentalidade; mas aquele que vos perturba, seja quem for, sofrerá o julgamento.

versos.grego: Ἐγὼ δέ, ἀδελφοί, εἰ περιτομὴν ἔτι κηρύσσω, τί ἔτι διώκομαι; ἄρα κατήργηται τὸ σκάνδαλον τοῦ σταυροῦ.

controles.web: But I, brothers, if I still preach circumcision, why am I still persecuted? Then the stumbling block of the cross has been removed.
controles.kjv: And I, brethren, if I yet preach circumcision, why do I yet suffer persecution? then is the offence of the cross ceased.
controles.livre: Mas se eu, irmãos, ainda prego a circuncisão, por que, então, sou perseguido? Então a ofensa da cruz está anulada!

versos.grego: Ὄφελον καὶ ἀποκόψονται οἱ ἀναστατοῦντες ὑμᾶς.

controles.web: I wish that those who disturb you would cut themselves off.
controles.kjv: I would they were even cut off which trouble you.
controles.livre: Gostaria que aqueles que estão vos perturbando castrassem a si mesmos.

versos.grego: Ὑμεῖς γὰρ ἐπ’ ἐλευθερίᾳ ἐκλήθητε, ἀδελφοί· μόνον μὴ τὴν ἐλευθερίαν εἰς ἀφορμὴν τῇ σαρκί, ἀλλὰ διὰ τῆς ἀγάπης δουλεύετε ἀλλήλοις.

controles.web: For you, brothers, were called for freedom. Only don’t use your freedom for gain to the flesh, but through love be servants to one another.
controles.kjv: For, brethren, ye have been called unto liberty; only use not liberty for an occasion to the flesh, but by love serve one another.
controles.livre: Pois vós, irmãos, fostes chamados para a liberdade. Somente não useis a liberdade como oportunidade para a carne; em vez disso, servi-vos uns aos outros pelo amor.

versos.grego: ὁ γὰρ πᾶς νόμος ἐν ἑνὶ λόγῳ πεπλήρωται, ἐν τῷ Ἀγαπήσεις τὸν πλησίον σου ὡς σεαυτόν.

controles.web: For the whole law is fulfilled in one word, in this: “You shall love your neighbor as yourself.”
controles.kjv: For all the law is fulfilled in one word, even in this; Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself.
controles.livre: Pois toda a Lei se cumpre em uma só regra, que é: Amarás ao teu próximo como a ti mesmo.

versos.grego: εἰ δὲ ἀλλήλους δάκνετε καὶ κατεσθίετε, βλέπετε μὴ ὑπ’ ἀλλήλων ἀναλωθῆτε.

controles.web: But if you bite and devour one another, be careful that you don’t consume one another.
controles.kjv: But if ye bite and devour one another, take heed that ye be not consumed one of another.
controles.livre: Se, porém, mordeis e devorais uns aos outros, cuidado para não vos destruirdes mutuamente.

versos.grego: Λέγω δέ, Πνεύματι περιπατεῖτε καὶ ἐπιθυμίαν σαρκὸς οὐ μὴ τελέσητε.

controles.web: But I say, walk by the Spirit, and you won’t fulfill the lust of the flesh.
controles.kjv: This I say then, Walk in the Spirit, and ye shall not fulfil the lust of the flesh.
controles.livre: Mas eu digo: andai no Espírito, e não executeis o mau desejo da carne.

versos.grego: ἡ γὰρ σὰρξ ἐπιθυμεῖ κατὰ τοῦ Πνεύματος, τὸ δὲ Πνεῦμα κατὰ τῆς σαρκός, ταῦτα γὰρ ἀλλήλοις ἀντίκειται, ἵνα μὴ ἃ ἐὰν θέλητε ταῦτα ποιῆτε.

controles.web: For the flesh lusts against the Spirit, and the Spirit against the flesh; and these are contrary to one another, that you may not do the things that you desire.
controles.kjv: For the flesh lusteth against the Spirit, and the Spirit against the flesh: and these are contrary the one to the other: so that ye cannot do the things that ye would.
controles.livre: Pois a carne deseja contra o Espírito, e o Espírito contra a carne; pois estes se opõem mutuamente, para que não façais o que quereis.

versos.grego: εἰ δὲ Πνεύματι ἄγεσθε, οὐκ ἐστὲ ὑπὸ νόμον.

controles.web: But if you are led by the Spirit, you are not under the law.
controles.kjv: But if ye be led of the Spirit, ye are not under the law.
controles.livre: Mas, se sois guiados pelo Espírito, não estais debaixo da Lei.

versos.grego: φανερὰ δέ ἐστιν τὰ ἔργα τῆς σαρκός, ἅτινά ἐστιν πορνεία, ἀκαθαρσία, ἀσέλγεια,

controles.web: Now the works of the flesh are obvious, which are: adultery, sexual immorality, uncleanness, lustfulness,
controles.kjv: Now the works of the flesh are manifest, which are these; Adultery, fornication, uncleanness, lasciviousness,
controles.livre: As obras da carne são evidentes. São elas:  pecado sexual, impureza, devassidão,

versos.grego: εἰδωλολατρεία, φαρμακεία, ἔχθραι, ἔρις, ζῆλος, θυμοί, ἐριθεῖαι, διχοστασίαι, αἱρέσεις,

controles.web: idolatry, sorcery, hatred, strife, jealousies, outbursts of anger, rivalries, divisions, heresies,
controles.kjv: Idolatry, witchcraft, hatred, variance, emulations, wrath, strife, seditions, heresies,
controles.livre: idolatria, feitiçaria, inimizades, brigas, ciúmes, iras, rivalidades egoístas, desavenças, facções,

versos.grego: φθόνοι, μέθαι, κῶμοι, καὶ τὰ ὅμοια τούτοις, ἃ προλέγω ὑμῖν καθὼς προεῖπον ὅτι οἱ τὰ τοιαῦτα πράσσοντες βασιλείαν Θεοῦ οὐ κληρονομήσουσιν.

controles.web: envyings, murders, drunkenness, orgies, and things like these; of which I forewarn you, even as I also forewarned you, that those who practice such things will not inherit the Kingdom of God.
controles.kjv: Envyings, murders, drunkenness, revellings, and such like: of the which I tell you before, as I have also told you in time past, that they which do such things shall not inherit the kingdom of God.
controles.livre: invejas,  bebedices, orgias, e coisas semelhantes a essas, das quais eu havia vos dito anteriormente; assim como eu também haviavos dito antes que os que praticam tais coisas não herdarão o Reino de Deus.

versos.grego: ὁ δὲ καρπὸς τοῦ Πνεύματός ἐστιν ἀγάπη, χαρά, εἰρήνη, μακροθυμία, χρηστότης, ἀγαθωσύνη, πίστις,

controles.web: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faith,
controles.kjv: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, longsuffering, gentleness, goodness, faith,
controles.livre: Mas o fruto do Espírito é: amor, alegria, paz, paciência, benignidade, bondade, fidelidade,

versos.grego: πραΰτης, ἐγκράτεια· κατὰ τῶν τοιούτων οὐκ ἔστιν νόμος.

controles.web: gentleness, and self-control. Against such things there is no law.
controles.kjv: Meekness, temperance: against such there is no law.
controles.livre: mansidão, domínio próprio. Contra essas coisas não há lei.

versos.grego: οἱ δὲ τοῦ Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ τὴν σάρκα ἐσταύρωσαν σὺν τοῖς παθήμασιν καὶ ταῖς ἐπιθυμίαις.

controles.web: Those who belong to Christ have crucified the flesh with its passions and lusts.
controles.kjv: And they that are Christ’s have crucified the flesh with the affections and lusts.
controles.livre: Os que são de Cristo Jesus crucificaram a carne com as paixões e os maus desejos.

versos.grego: Εἰ ζῶμεν Πνεύματι, Πνεύματι καὶ στοιχῶμεν.

controles.web: If we live by the Spirit, let’s also walk by the Spirit.
controles.kjv: If we live in the Spirit, let us also walk in the Spirit.
controles.livre: Se vivemos no Espírito, também no Espírito andemos.

versos.grego: μὴ γινώμεθα κενόδοξοι, ἀλλήλους προκαλούμενοι, ἀλλήλοις φθονοῦντες.

controles.web: Let’s not become conceited, provoking one another, and envying one another.
controles.kjv: Let us not be desirous of vain glory, provoking one another, envying one another.
controles.livre: Não nos tornemos presunçosos, irritando uns aos outros, e invejando uns aos outros.
